UpdateStageDescription: Saving config, rotation, whitelist and ban files, since the server update replaces them
UpdateSourceArgs: (if not exist config-backup mkdir config-backup) & (for %f in (ServerInfo.ini ServerConfiguration.ini MapRotation.txt MpCampaign.txt Whitelist.txt Banlist.txt TempBanlist.txt) do @if exist 3052620\%f copy /y 3052620\%f config-backup\%f >nul) & exit /b 0

UpdateStageDescription: Saving config, rotation, whitelist and ban files, since the server update replaces them
UpdateSourceArgs: mkdir -p config-backup && for f in ServerInfo.ini ServerConfiguration.ini MapRotation.txt MpCampaign.txt Whitelist.txt Banlist.txt TempBanlist.txt; do if [ -f 3052620/$f ]; then cp -f 3052620/$f config-backup/$f; fi; done

UpdateStageDescription: Putting back the saved config, rotation, whitelist and ban files
UpdateSourceArgs: (for %f in (ServerInfo.ini ServerConfiguration.ini MapRotation.txt MpCampaign.txt Whitelist.txt Banlist.txt TempBanlist.txt) do @if exist config-backup\%f copy /y config-backup\%f 3052620\%f >nul) & exit /b 0

UpdateSourceArgs: for f in ServerInfo.ini ServerConfiguration.ini MapRotation.txt MpCampaign.txt Whitelist.txt Banlist.txt TempBanlist.txt; do if [ -f config-backup/$f ]; then cp -f config-backup/$f 3052620/$f; fi; done
